description: This Java class defines a GUI component named RpmLabel that displays the RPM value in a user interface. It updates dynamically based on RPM sensor data and connection status, showing 'Noise' when RPM data is unavailable and changing color based on connection state.

classes.description: A GUI component that displays RPM status with dynamic updating based on sensor and connection events.
